```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
library(bdynets)
if(!file.exists(params$results_file)) stop('Supply an existing RDS study. This report does not fit models.')
study<-lpr_read(params$results_file)
summary<-lpr_report(params$results_file,params$output_dir)
```

## Source and scope

This report reads saved results and never calls MCMC. The source is
**`r study$provenance$engine`**. The canonical result artifact is
`r normalizePath(params$results_file)`.

The model is Poisson with an intercept, centered endpoint effects, and centered
bounded latent positions. No GP is included. Historical imports preserve their
original four chains and 2,000 stored draws per chain; they are not relabeled as R
fits. A `quick` R run is an execution check only, not convergence evidence.

## Aligned position recovery

```{r plot, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(params$output_dir,'aligned_positions.png'))
```

Circles are true centered positions and crosses are recovered posterior means.
Each gray segment joins the same node. All posterior draws are first aligned to a fixed reference chosen
without truth, then averaged. The resulting mean is aligned to truth for
simulation evaluation by an orthogonal transformation allowing reflections.
Neither stage rescales positions. Both panels use the same axes and aspect ratio.
The plot shows point estimates, not credible regions.

```{r scores}
knitr::kable(summary,digits=3,row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r historical-caution, results='asis'}
if(grepl('Python',study$provenance$engine)) cat('For these historical draws, the exposure-10 run has worst interaction Rhat 1.0121 (above 1.01), interval inclusion 0.906, and an intercept interval excluding truth. These limitations remain. Only one true configuration was simulated; point recovery does not establish interval calibration or sparse-road recovery. Historical imports lack raw endpoint and RNG checkpoints and cannot be continued.') else cat('This is a new R run. Inspect chain diagnostics and the recorded profile before drawing inferential conclusions. Historical manuscript metrics do not apply to these draws.')
```
